title: ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOWSIX: SIEGE - OPERATION ORIGINIUM DUST OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: OPERATION ORIGINIUM DUST OPEN
EVENT DURATION: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 8, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Operation Originium Dust event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
[Task Record] Duration: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Para Bellum] Duration: August 25, 2021, 16:00 (UTC-7) - September 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[COMBAT REPORT]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete missions to obtain rewards by clearing event stages.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Tachanka, Special Equipment Exhibition Room Furniture (Pieces), Rhodes Island Supply Ration Coupons.
[COMMISSARY]
DURATION: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 8, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Rhodes Island Supply Ration Coupons by clearing event stages and missions in Combat Report. Rhodes Island Supply Ration Coupons can be used to redeem items from Commissary.
MAIN REWARDS: Tachanka's Token, Special Equipment Exhibition Room Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, Elite Materials, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
02 LIMITED HEADHUNTING OPEN – ATTACK, DEFENCE, TACTICAL COLLIDE
DURATION: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited Headhunting, "Attack, Defence, Tactical Collide", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
★★★★★: Frost / Blitz
NOTE:

Headhunting "Attack, Defence, Tactical Collide" is a Limited Headhunting. New Operator Ash, Frost and Blitz can ONLY be obtained from "Attack, Defence, Tactical Collide" and will NOT appear in other Standard Headhunting.
03 ATTACK, DEFENCE, TACTICAL COLLIDE LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [ Expert Headhunting Permit] * 1 as login reward.
NOTE:
[Expert Headhunting Permit] can only be used in the Limited Headhunting "Attack, Defence, Tactical Collide"
[Expert Headhunting Permit] will be expired on September 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
This login reward only can be obtained once for each account
04 ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOWSIX: SIEGE SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can sign in cumulatively for 7 days to claim the following rewards.
Day 1: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 2, LMD * 10000
Day 2: Scope * 1, Skill Summary - 1 * 30
Day 3: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Strategic Battle Record * 10
Day 4: Orundum * 200, Orirock Cube * 6
Day 5: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Day 6: Contested Objective * 1, Originite Prime * 1
Day 7: Expert Headhunting Permit * 1, Chip Catalyst * 1
NOTE:
The Top Emergency Sanity Potions will be expired on September 6, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Expert Headhunting Permit] will be expired on September 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Players can earn all the rewards even without signing in consecutively.
05 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE IN HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: The following Operators will ONLY appear at Limited Headhunting "Attack, Defence, Tactical Collide", and will NOT be added to other Headhunting.
★★★★★: Frost
★★★★★: Blitz
★★★★★: Tachanka
NOTE:
Operator Tachanka is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Operation Originium Dust.
Ash, Frost, Blitz, and Tachanka will gain more trust during this event.
06 ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOWSIX: SIEGE NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Rainbow Six Collab Series - Ranger for Ash
Rainbow Six Collab Series - Lord for Tachanka
Raythean Striker Collection - Skyline for Schwarz
Raythean Striker Collection - Overload for Liskarm
07 ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOWSIX: SIEGE LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DURATION: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at Store for a limited-time.
[POSITION DEFENSE PACK]
INCLUDES: LMD * 50000, Tactical Battle Record * 50, Guard Chip * 4, Oriron * 4, Sugar * 3
[COMMON TACTICAL PACK]
INCLUDES: Originite Prime * 13, Headhunting Permit * 1, Strategic Battle Record * 25, LMD * 100000, Defender Chip * 4, Sugar * 5, Device * 2, Specialist Chip * 4, Polyester * 5, Orirock Cube * 4
[ASSAULT ELITE PACK]
INCLUDES: Originite Prime * 24, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 2, Tactical Battle Record * 30, LMD * 60000, Sniper Chip * 5, Orirock Cube * 11, Oriron * 5, Furniture Part * 1000
08 NEW FURNITURE SET - SPECIAL EQUIPMENT EXHIBITION ROOM
DURATION: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Special Equipment Exhibition Room, will be available during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Operation Originium Dust event rewards and redeem in Commissary (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
09 NEW LUCKY DROP THEMED FURNITURE SET - WALTER INTERIOR SENSATIONS
UPDATE TIME: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DROP FURNITURE: Walter Interior Sensations
HOW TO COLLECT: Lucky drop on every stage of Main Storyline Episode 1-8 (excluding Challenge Mode and Training Mission) and every stage in Supplies.
DETAILS:

New lucky drop furniture set Walter Interior Sensations will replace the current lucky drop furniture set Rhodes Island HR Office. After the replacement, Rhodes Island HR Office themed furniture set will be available at the Store.
NOTE:
Rhodes Island HR Office will be available at the Store after August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7).
10 ID RESET CARD FREE TO CLAIM FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DETAILS: After the event begins, one ID Reset Card will be sent to players via in-game mail. Players can use this item to change in-game nickname.
SENDING TIME: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DURATION: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
REQUIREMENT:
All the players who have logged in and created a character before October 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7), NOT including guest accounts.
NOTE:
After using ID Reset Card, the “#number” right after players’ nickname will be changed randomly.
ID Reset Card is only free to claim for a limited-time this time, please pay attention to related update notices for more details.
11 MULTIVARIATE COOPERATION: DEFENCE PROTOCOLS OPEN
EVENT STAGE DURATION: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-10 and Operation Originium Dust Event Stage OD-1
DETAILS: The brand new game mode Multivariate Cooperation will be open during the event. Players can match, invite, or join another player to complete the challenge together.
Players can obtain Rhodes Island Supply Ration Coupons and other rewards by completing event missions. Rhodes Island Supply Ration Coupons can be used to redeem items from Commissary.
[COMMISSARY]
DURATION: August 18, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 8, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
MAIN REWARDS: Tachanka's Token, Special Equipment Exhibition Room Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, Elite Materials, etc.
